# Buddhi Align: Open Practice Documentation

> Open documentation for Buddhi Align, written by Aarti S Ravikumar.

## Author

- [Aarti S Ravikumar](https://ai-aarti.com/)

## Canonical resources

- [Documentation home](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/): Open practice documentation.
- [Practice guide](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/practice-guide.html): A gentle routine for planning, practice, reflection, and review.
- [Official sources](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/open-web-reference.html): Canonical public Buddhi Align references.
- [Wiki home](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/wiki/): Open learning, practice, and source-indexing documentation.
- [Wiki practice guide](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/wiki/practice-guide.html): A gentle guide to planning, practicing, reflecting, and reviewing.
- [Wiki publishing guide](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/wiki/publishing.html): Canonical source and publication workflow for the documentation.
- [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/aartisr/buddhi-align-app/wiki): Native GitHub mirror of the maintained Wiki.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/aartisr/buddhi-align-app): Reviewed source for the app, documentation, PWA, and discovery operations.
- [Author and publisher](https://ai-aarti.com/): Aarti S Ravikumar.
- [Buddhi Align](https://buddhi-align.foreverlotus.com/): The authoritative product site for current features, support, and updates.
- [Product LLMs reference](https://buddhi-align.foreverlotus.com/llms.txt): AI-readable information for the live product.
